China accused of supplying Russia with drone materials for Ukraine war

China is allegedly supplying Russia with materials for explosive drone components, according to reports. One report claims China sent 46 tons of such material to a sanctioned Russian company. Meanwhile, fighting between Russia and Ukraine has intensified amidst ongoing talks. Ukrainian drones reportedly attacked Russia's Perm region, hitting a residential building, resulting in one death and four injuries. Russia also launched aerial attacks on Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, causing a fire in a shopping mall and disrupting power to 1200 shops.
